question: Motion to Waive All Applicable Budgetary Discipline Re: Padilla Amdt. No. 4855
bill_title: A concurrent resolution setting forth the congressional budget for the United States Government for fiscal year 2026 and setting forth the appropriate budgetary levels for fiscal years 2027 through 2035.
plain_language: This vote was on waiving budget rules so an amendment to S.Con.Res. 33 could be considered. The sponsor's official statement of purpose for the amendment: “To create a point of order against reconciliation legislation that would provide funding to Federal agencies that have unobligated funds from previous reconciliation bills.” Waiving needs 60 votes (three-fifths). A Yea supports the waiver; a Nay keeps the budget point of order in place, which blocks the amendment.
